article.title: Blocking Authoritarian Consolidation w/Scot Nakagawa
article.author: Cayden Mak
article.content: Almost everyone keeping tabs on the Trump administration’s moves to consolidate authoritarian power recognized that shoring up this month’s midterm elections was crucial to blocking MAGA’s strategy. Much of Convergence’s own publishing in the past months has focused on the importance of defending the election and monitoring the plays that were being made in the attempt to subvert or outright steal… Source
